name: cfoil_intens_kulfan_trim_2
description: Intens SY C-foil (single circular arc, R 9.8 m, wetted arc 3.25 m, chord 0.70 m, fixed area): optimization of its ONE constant Kulfan section (4+4 weights, thickness/camber form) for the minimum 3D drag AT THE SAME 3D LIFT AS THE REFERENCE FOIL: for every section and level the yaw is trimmed (secant) until |(Cy, Cz)| equals the lift of the reference section at the nominal attitude (heel 5 + trunk cant 3.28 deg, rake 0.5 deg, yaw 4 deg, sink 0), and the objective is CD = -Cx at the trimmed yaw. The trimmed yaw must stay within +-5 % of 4 deg. No 2D lift constraint: 8 variables, thickness t_0..t_3, camber shape s_1..s_3 and yaw_target in [3.85, 4.15] deg (band 3.8-4.2 minus the yaw-model error); the camber offset delta (c_i = delta + s_i) is solved so that the level-1 yaw model (study_trim.YawModel, fitted by step 0) gives yaw_target. Reference section = the one of the first study (../cfoil_intens_kulfan): thickness of MC2_60_6101_1 (Kulfan 4+4 fit, t/c 12.25 %) + frozen camber delta C(x), delta = 0.108139. Hull = wall (symmetry plane z = 0). Known section constraints (study_trim.py): t/c >= 0.1225, Ixx >= reference, thickness at x/c 0.90 and 0.95 >= reference, leading-edge weights (upper_0 > 0.05, lower_0 < -0.05), wiggliness < 2 x reference, NeuralFoil xxxlarge confidence > 0.9. Re 5e6, n_crit 1, xtr 0.1 at every level. Levels: NPLLT x NeuralFoil xxxlarge, NPLLT x XFOIL, AVL x XFOIL (bdFoil core, same XFOIL polars).
